reviews.text: One word...Fabulous! The staff and Dr. Effie are fabulous! Our experience has been nothing short of great from check-in to check-out. They are taking great care of my bunnies!

Dr. Effie goes above and beyond. She has taken such great care of us and our dog for 6 years. She always makes a point to personally address every concern even if it means staying late to respond to all of the messages she’s received that day. She is never hurried and addresses every concern with her characteristic calm and knowledgeable manner. Every time we hear from Dr. Effie we are so appreciative of her thoughtfulness, patience and care. 10 out of 10 recommend!!

My whole family raves about this place. We have a dog who is by his nature basically a bag of springs... even in his old age. And a little bit reactive. Other vets have insisted we drug him on the days he's coming in.  Dr. Effie took the time to get to know him and discovered that once our dog no longer feels he's guarding us, he becomes the most friendly dog in the place.

Isn't this the kind of wisdom and ability that you want in the professional who is taking care of your family's mascot(s)?

Highly recommended.
Dr. Effie has been our vet for two decades and she's the kindest,  most capable vet you could ask for!

Highly recommend Dr. Effie! She’s been incredible with my bunny Nova and really understands rabbit care. Couldn’t ask for a better vet! 🐇✨Small animal expert, very experienced, and truly wants the best care for your pets.

Have always appreciated the kind care CityVet provides. Today, Dr. Mika, Erica and the whole staff at the Old East Dallas location helped us with an emergency with a stray dog we came across and were tremendously helpful, had a sense of urgency and were so caring throughout. Highly recommend this location, this is what compassionate medical care looks like!
Went in for a teeth cleaning for my dachshund and they were super helpful and kind! Love this place
The staff here was wonderful!  From the moment we walked in and throughout our visit they were attentive and helpful.

Dr. Effie is brilliant and one of the best rabbit vets out there. I’ve been going to her for many years now and she is such a kind, personable, and passionate person. She has been able to navigate through my minilop bunny’s otitis and even did surgery on her to remove an abscess, and Basil recovered so well, as Dr. Effie reassured confidence in such. I can’t recommend her enough!!!
Very nice clinic,friendly and caring staff.  And time efficient which is hard to come by at most other vet clinics.

We love CityVet! We moved & switched to the East Dallas location. Our newest puppy is a troublemaker so we are so thankful for Dr. Gionnopoulos, Junna, and the entire team!  We had an emergency and they took amazing care of our girl. I would recommend this location to anyone.
Dr. Effie was so great when I had to put my rabbit to sleep. Her bedside manner as a doctor is fantastic. She was kind and comforting during a really hard time.
Effie is my heart and soul. I’ve been taking my pup since she was a puppy. The most compassionate person and a wealth of knowledge. The absolute best vet in Dallas!
Dr Effie has been my vet and friend for 16 plus years as she took care of my sister’s pets as well. She is the most caring, patient soul and I just love her! My pets do too! ♥️

This is the best city vet in town! Everyone is nice and kind and polite. The place is the cleanest and the service just chef kiss. Dr Effie is just the most caring and compassionate vet I have ever met and she takes rabbits!
